name: Question 9
problem:
Find the values of $k$ such that the vector $b$ lies in $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}},$ where

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 7 \\ 4\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -7 \\ k\end{aligned}].
$$
worked_solution:
We know that $b\in \text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ if there exist ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2} & =b \\ {x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ -3 \\ -2\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}-4 \\ 7 \\ 4\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -7 \\ k\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

So, we have the following system of equations:

$$
{\begin{aligned}2{x}_{1}-4{x}_{2}=8 \\ -3{x}_{1}+7{x}_{2}=-7 \\ -2{x}_{1}+4{x}_{2}=k\end{aligned}
$$

To solve the system above, we set up and row reduce an augmented matrix:

$$
\begin{aligned} & [\begin{aligned}2 & -4 & 8 \\ -3 & 7 & -7 \\ -2 & 4 & k\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{2}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 4 \\ -3 & 7 & -7 \\ -2 & 4 & k\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ -2 & 4 & k\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & k+8\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The third row of the augmented matrix now corresponds to the equation $0{x}_{1}+0{x}_{2}=k+8.$ Therefore, the system has a solution only if

$$
0=k+8\,⇒\,k=-8.
$$
